summary: Tested Phase 1 class CRUD, optional sections, roster assignment, teacher global visibility/privacy, homework freedom, teacher read-only UI, student class isolation, required auth controls, and production build against the public preview. Class create/edit, global redacted /students list, all-class i_teach list, cross-class homework, teacher read-only controls, and student class isolation pass. Assignment is unimplemented, non-taught roster viewing is blocked, and alternate teacher student endpoints leak principal-only data.

critical.issue: Endpoint is absent and returns 404. Principal Add Selected shows Not Found, no student is assigned, and roster/count cannot refresh.

Teachers receive 403 'Not your batch' for non-taught classes, contradicting the required all-class read-only View Students flow. For taught classes the response also leaks parent_phone and monthly_fee instead of applying teacher redaction.
Teacher requests return principal-only fields. Reproduced leakage of parent_phone, parent_email, and monthly_fee for a same-institute student.
OTP completion does not set an application HttpOnly/Secure access_token cookie, and credentialed CORS is disabled instead of using explicit origins.
Existing super-admin password_hash is not updated when SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD changes; the seed only inserts when no account exists.

integration_issues.issue: Picker opens and selection works, but Add Selected receives 404 and displays a Not Found toast because the backend assign route is missing.

integration_issues.flow: Teacher View Students on non-taught class
integration_issues.issue: All class cards render a View Students control, but clicking one for a non-taught populated class receives 403 and displays 'Not your batch' with an empty roster dialog.

action_items: Implement principal-only POST /batches/{bid}/assign with institute-scoped batch/student validation and return moved count; then refresh roster and class count.
Allow teachers to GET rosters for every class in their institute and apply _strip_contact to every returned student.
Apply teacher redaction to GET /students/{sid}; audit all teacher-accessible student endpoints so contact and fee fields remain principal-only.
Set the secure HttpOnly auth cookie after successful OTP and configure credentialed CORS with explicit allowed origins, or formally revise the auth requirement.
Make ensure_super_admin idempotently update the configured password for an existing super-admin.
Retest principal assignment plus teacher roster/privacy through API and UI after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: Batches.jsx calls /batches/{id}/assign, but server.py defines no matching route; this is a frontend/backend contract omission.

batch_students explicitly enforces teacher_batches membership and returns raw student documents, causing both the 403 freedom defect and PII/fee leakage; get_student likewise returns raw data to any authenticated same-institute user.
server.py is 4,363 lines and contains duplicate startup/shutdown/root blocks; split it into focused modules and remove duplicate lifecycle registration.
ensure_super_admin only inserts on absence, so configuration-based password rotation can never update an existing account.
The production build passes but reports existing React hook dependency and html5-qrcode source-map warnings.

success_rate.frontend: 75% of targeted UI subflows (principal load/create/edit and teacher sidebar/read-only/homework passed; assignment and non-taught roster view failed)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable API/UI classes and homework; all were removed. Assignment returned 404, so no student batch was changed. Disposable lockout data used the existing test fixture cleanup.
test_credentials: Used JWTs minted from configured JWT_SECRET for principal Dr. Shivam Mantri, teacher Anita Sharma in institute 42c4f12d, and student Saanvi Singh, as instructed. /app/auth_testing.md is absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview and production build load. Final Phase 1 pytest consistently has 4 failures: missing assign route, 403 non-taught roster, detail PII leak, taught-roster PII leak. Teacher UI has exactly 4 cards, no New/Edit/Delete/Email controls, and View Students + Timetable PDF on each; cross-class homework UI/API succeeds. Principal no-section create and edit-to-section-B persist. Required auth controls still fail cookie, CORS, and super-admin password rotation.
rca_of_the_issue: The roster feature is only partially wired: frontend assignment UI was added without its backend route. Existing batch_students retained old teacher ownership authorization and returns unredacted documents. The new _strip_contact helper is used only by list_students, leaving detail/roster endpoints as bypasses. Auth failures come from no set_cookie call, CORSMiddleware allow_credentials=False, and insert-only ensure_super_admin logic.
